newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still an ING buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still an ING buy.

text.p: ING Barings said it was maintaining its buy rating on Brazilian telecommunications firm Telebras.
-- Analysts Patrick E. Jurczak and Vera Rossi said in a report they were reiterating the buy recommendation, although the shares have risen significantly during the year.

-- "There is still good news pending that should provide more upward support for the shares," they said, citing the sale of the Band B cellular services, a decline in local interest rates, and progress in Congress of the new telecom law.
-- also said the company's results for May were modest, but noted they may be the result of monthly seasonal factors.
-- Telebras posted net income of 214 million reais in May.
-- Telebras preferred, the benchmark stock of the Sao Paulo bolsa, was up 0.06 percent at 176 reais earlier.
